title: Melting Time Spiral
description: A surreal scene shows a bearded man in a grey t-shirt sitting inside a red Radio Flyer wagon shaped like a melting clock, while a blonde woman in a flowing black dress holds his hand. They float above a glowing spiral vortex containing a small purple mouse standing on a tiny melting clock, surrounded by falling pink petals and multiple melting clocks in a dreamy landscape.
prompt: Surreal painting of a bearded man sitting in a red Radio Flyer wagon designed as a melting clock, holding hands with a beautiful blonde woman in a flowing black dress whose hair is made of clock hands and petals. They hover above a swirling colorful time vortex where a small purple mouse stands on a melting clock. Multiple melting clocks float in a dreamy grassy landscape under a cloudy sky with falling pink petals, whimsical and fantastical atmosphere.
